rows.v: Listen and Repeat 7 题；Take an Interview 4 题，共 11 题。
两类题每题均为 0–5 分；5 分为单题满分。
每句的录音作答时限为 8–12 秒，随句子而异。
提交口头录音作答，由人工智能评分系统评价。
rows.src: spec 第 2、6 页；overview 第 17 页

cards.title: 题型
rows: Listen and Repeat
学术或校园情境及示意图；句子逐渐加长。
逐句听后原样复述，不换成同义句。
Take an Interview
预先录制的面试问题，围绕同一主题展开。
先回答事实或经历，再表达并支持观点。

cards.title: 评分要点
rows: 跟读：准确
词和语序与原句一致。换成同义词也算错。
The locker is empty. → The cabinet is empty.（换词）
跟读：完整
功能词和词尾都要说出来。只说出大意不算完整。
The lockers are empty. → Lockers are empty.（漏词）
跟读：可懂度
每个词的发音都能听清。
The lockers are empty.（lockers 的词尾须可辨认）
面试：切题与展开
回答问到的内容，再补充相关细节。重复题目不算展开。
Why join the club? → It offers supervised practice.
面试：语流与可懂度
语速自然，在意思完整处停顿，不频繁中断。
I joined last autumn / because I wanted more practice.
面试：词汇与语法
用词和语法准确，句式有变化。复杂句式要用来表达意思。
Although I was new, I could contribute a useful idea.

groups.text: Listen and Repeat contains seven sentences in a shared setting. Take an Interview contains four related questions. The speaking section takes about eight minutes.

items.stem: Which description matches Listen and Repeat?
options: Seven sentences to reproduce within a scenario
Four questions to reproduce within a scenario
Seven questions requiring personal opinions
Four sentences requiring personal opinions
items.why: 依据是 seven sentences in a shared setting：在同一情境里复述 7 句。4 题是面试的题量。

items.stem: Which description applies to the whole speaking section?
options: Seven tasks in approximately four minutes
Eleven tasks in approximately eight minutes
Four tasks in approximately eight minutes
Eleven tasks in approximately seven minutes
items.why: seven sentences 加 four related questions 共 11 题。about eight minutes 是整个部分的用时。

groups.text: A repeat response is recorded within an 8-to-12-second limit, depending on the sentence. Each interview response has 45 seconds. Both task types use a 0-to-5 scoring scale.

items.stem: Which pairing is correct for an interview item?
options: An 8-to-12-second response; a maximum of 5 points
A 45-second response; a maximum of 12 points
An 8-to-12-second response; a maximum of 45 points
A 45-second response; a maximum of 5 points
items.why: Each interview response has 45 seconds 给出时限，0-to-5 scoring scale 给出单题满分 5 分。

items.stem: A repeat response changes several words but remains understandable. Which requirement is directly affected?
options: The requirement to express a supported personal opinion
The requirement to answer a related interview question
The requirement to reproduce the original wording accurately
The requirement to elaborate within a 45-second answer
items.why: changes several words 说明原词被换掉了，影响的是第三项说的准确复述。能听懂不能抵消换词。

groups.text: An interview response should address the question, add relevant development, maintain a conversational pace, and communicate clearly with suitable grammar and vocabulary.

items.stem: A speaker answers a question about a preference but keeps repeating the preference without reasons. Which area needs improvement?
options: The accuracy of reproducing a recorded sentence
The amount of relevant support for the answer
The number of questions included in the interview
The accuracy of repeating the interviewer word for word
items.why: 依据是 add relevant development。反复说偏好，没有增加支持的理由。

items.stem: A response is relevant and detailed, but frequent long pauses make it difficult to follow. Which requirement is most directly affected?
options: Maintaining a coherent flow at a conversational pace
Repeating all the words of a recorded sentence
Keeping the answer within the original sentence order
Developing a preference with additional relevant reasons
items.why: frequent long pauses 不符合 maintain a conversational pace。题干已说明内容相关、细节充分。
